_meta.description: Japanese community B3 damage-ranking name -> nikke-sim slug. Keys are the EXACT `name` strings in docs/data/ranks/{neutral,ele_adv_nikke}_scores.csv (owner-supplied third-party lists, gitignored). Used by scripts/audit-b3-ranks.ts to line the community ranking up against the sim's own Burst-3 DPS chart.
_meta.resolvedFrom: bakery-bot Postgres table nikke_name_dictionary (Japanese shorthand -> canonical English NIKKE name), joined to data/characters.json by name; the community-nickname forms not in that dictionary were resolved by hand and carry `confidence`.

conventions.slug: the nikke-sim slug the row is compared against; null when the row names a unit the roster has no slug for
conventions.variant: present when the community row is a COMP/BUILD/SLOT-conditioned entry rather than a plain unit row (the sim chart's own profile rows are named where one matches)
conventions.simProfile: the dpschart profile id this variant corresponds to, when the sim models it as a separate row
conventions.treasure: the community list scores Treasure and non-Treasure separately for some units; the sim models only ONE row, which is the Treasure build (data/characters.json names them "X (Treasure)", and the validation basis is "treasure on") — `withTreasure` marks the comparable row, `noTreasure` the one that has no sim counterpart, and `unmarked` a unit the sim models with its Treasure but which the community list scores exactly once, with no 宝もの marker to say which build that row is
conventions.compConditioned: the row's score depends on a named PARTNER the sim's control frameworks do not field, so it cannot be scored against a chart cell; the audit reports these separately instead of ranking them
conventions.confidence: low = resolution is uncertain and the audit reports it as unresolved rather than scoring it

紅蓮(トリナ).variant: paired with Trina — the sim's control frameworks field no Trina, so this row has no comparable cell

冬ディーゼル(2番手).variant: second B3 slot — opens in Highlight rather than Intro

イサベル(アルカナ).variant: paired with an Arcana — the row does not disambiguate `arcana` from `arcana-fortune-mate`, and the sim's control frameworks field neither, so this row has no comparable cell

ブレッディ(持続).variant: sustained-damage branch (the sim chart's default Bready row)

A2(Bモード維持).variant: B-mode held (the stance the sim does not separately model)

キリ.variant: the name dictionary resolves キリ to Quiry, a Burst-2 Supporter — every other row on this list is a Burst-3, so the resolution is not trusted and the row is reported unresolved rather than scored
